body: Diffusion-based models decompose sampling into many small Gaussian denoising steps, an assumption that breaks down when generation is compressed to a few coarse transitions. Existing few-step methods address this through distillation, consistency training, or adversarial objectives, but sacrifice the likelihood framework in the process. We introduce Normalizing Trajectory Models (NTM), which models each reverse step as an expressive conditional normalizing flow with exact likelihood training. summaryZh: Apple 机器学习团队介绍了归一化轨迹模型（Normalizing Trajectory Models, NTM）。该方法旨在解决扩散模型在压缩采样步数时性能下降的问题，通过将每个反向步骤建模为具有精确似然训练的条件归一化流，结合浅层可逆块与深度并行架构，在保持似然框架的同时提升了生成质量与效率。
